propositions: The documented curl command to install commit-msg hook resolves to the shared hooks directory via git rev-parse --git-path, clobbering the hook for all worktrees when run from a linked worktree
The curl overwrite destroys the pre-commit wrapper and breaks the chained arrangement where both pre-commit validation and Gerrit Change-Id stamping should run, causing silent failures at push time
Installation must be made idempotent, non-destructive, cwd-independent, and loud on unsafe overwrites by folding the Gerrit hook install into make hooks with a dedicated installation script
The fix writes to commit-msg.legacy when a pre-commit wrapper owns commit-msg, validates the fetched payload contains Change-Id logic, and refuses to overwrite non-wrapper hooks
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must stop instructing a bare curl over git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg and redirect to make hooks
After installation, commits must receive Change-Id stamps and remain subject to pre-commit validation gates, verified by testing from both main checkout and linked worktrees
